I have farmed here in the North East for many years, and on this small maize plot I will use a small amount of inorganic fertilizer because the soil in our area needs it for maize to grow well. I save my own seed from the previous harvest and do not irrigate, since we depend on the rains, and I do not buy pesticides because they are too costly for this plot. My family will do most of the work, but I will hire a few laborers during the busy planting and weeding time since we have many hectares to manage across the farm.
